text: As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates a transit service on Rogers Road, City Council approval of this report is required. Transportation Services is requesting approval to designate a School Bus Loading Zone on the south side of Rogers Road close to the school's entrance to provide a safe pick-up/drop-off area for students attending St. Nicholas of Bari Catholic School, located at 363 Rogers Road.
The Toronto and East York Community Council deferred consideration of the item until its May 22, 2019 meeting.
